title: ICAI Announces Mock Test Papers Series I & II for CA Final November 2026 Exams
content:
# ICAI Announces Mock Test Papers Series I & II for CA Final November 2026 Exams

Ek important update hai. The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne CA Final November 2026 Examinations ke liye Mock Test Papers Series I & II announce kiye hain. This is a crucial step to help students prepare effectively.

Here are the key details:
*   **Announcement Date:** The Board of Studies (Academic) of ICAI issued this announcement on August 10, 2026.
*   **Purpose:** These mock tests are designed to help students assess their preparation levels, enhance time management skills, and build confidence before the actual November 2026 examinations.
*   **Mock Test Paper Series I Schedule:** This series will be conducted from September 9 to September 21, 2026.
*   **Mock Test Paper Series II Schedule:** Following Series I, the second series will run from September 23 to October 5, 2026.
*   **Mode of Test:** Students have the flexibility to appear for these mock tests in both physical and virtual modes.
*   **Accessing Papers and Keys:** Question papers for each subject will be uploaded on the BoS Knowledge Portal and MTP Registration Portal by 9:30 AM on the scheduled dates. Answer keys will be available within 48 hours of the commencement of each paper. For physical mode, students can contact their respective ICAI branches or regional offices for registration.
